title: The convergence of data science and catalysis: a comprehensive review of machine learning applications in accelerating selective catalytic reduction (SCR) catalyst design and performance prediction
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1830-1852
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00610D, Critical Review
Chengzheng Tong, Qingling Liu, Hu Wang, Mingfa Yao
This review critically assesses ML approaches—from traditional algorithms to LLMs—for accelerating SCR catalyst design, highlighting data limitations and pathways toward knowledge-guided NOx abatement solutions.
